implementation: SQLite schema v2 for projects, skills, bot_profiles, runs, handoffs, approval_requests, sources, artifacts, memory_items and provider_receipts
Run creation and RunEvent creation in one transaction
Run transition, RunEvent append and idempotency record in one transaction
Run segment append and restart readback
same-key replay returns the original transition; same-key different action fails
runtime default store uses SqliteRunStore with an isolated temp database under Node test
limitations: Product Builder continuity still records idempotency keys in event data and does not yet atomically write checkpoint, snapshot and idempotency rows through this store.
Project/Bot/Handoff/Approval/Source/Artifact/Memory/ProviderReceipt tables exist, but typed CRUD repositories and receipts are not implemented.
The cross-process test covers three concurrent writer processes and does not replace long-running lock, kill/restart, or 10k/100k event scale validation in M10-06.
The runtime store is now SQLite-first, but a SQLite-unavailable production process fails closed; portable JSONL remains an explicit event/snapshot fallback and is not a RunStore fallback.
Schema and runtime persistence evidence does not prove model quality or real-world productivity.
next_action: Enter M10-05: atomically persist Product Builder checkpoint, ContextSnapshot and idempotency rows, then expose the same SQLite-backed state through HTTP.
